## C2 — KG handoff: Suspensions and record

FACT_ID: sec13-R01 | anchor: A01
Showing a canceled, suspended, or altered license, or altering a license, can bring suspension [A01]
Why it matters: group license-fraud; prereq none; difficulty 1; confusable sec13-R03 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec13-R02 | anchor: A01
Routine moving convictions stay on the record for three years, while alcohol and drug actions stay for ten years [A01]
Why it matters: group record-retention; prereq none; difficulty 2; confusable sec13-R04 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec13-R03 | anchor: A02
Suspension and revocation differ, with repeat intoxicated control and false sworn statements leading to revocation [A02]
Why it matters: group suspension-vs-revocation; prereq sec13-R01; difficulty 3; confusable sec13-R01 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec13-R04 | anchor: A03
A hearing is triggered at two hundred points in three years for older drivers and seventy points for younger drivers [A03]
Why it matters: group point-thresholds; prereq none; difficulty 2; confusable sec13-R05 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec13-R05 | anchor: A04
Half the points clear after one clean year, all clear after two clean years, and one course removes fifty points [A04]
Why it matters: group point-clearing; prereq sec13-R04; difficulty 2; confusable sec13-R04 [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0083]
